continuity.arc_goal: Implement linked workflows with complete lifecycle management: MVP (create/complete/cancel/remove), post-MVP (HandlerInvocation/onCompleted, bidirectional link records, purge guard, cross-partition Link GC). Feature complete with 15 clean commits.

progress_update.summary: We completed the full linked workflows feature including Link GC. Implemented bidirectional link records (EdgeLabel::ParentOf/ChildOf), purge guard, RemoveParentLink cross-partition notification, cycle prevention, VO clear state cleanup. Fixed all review findings: edge_label in RocksDB key for indexed scans, self-link guard, VO clear state only deletes outgoing links, race condition check-before-write on ChildOf. Renamed is_linked_to to are_linked. Cleaned commit history (split docs from code). Archived both plans. 15 code-only commits, 11 tests passing.
progress_update.goal: Linked workflows with lifecycle management: bidirectional links, purge guard, cross-partition cleanup, cycle prevention. Feature complete.

Deferred: GetLinkCommand for handler access to link state
Deferred: Transitive cycle detection (A→B→C→A), orphan GC policy
constraints: edge_label is part of RocksDB key for directed prefix scans
are_linked does two point reads (ParentOf + ChildOf)
VO clear state only deletes ParentOf links, preserves ChildOf
Check-before-write on ChildOf in AttachInvocation prevents race condition overwrite
Direct cycles prevented by key collision; transitive cycles not detected
Cross-partition links from day one — all link operations use outbox messages
Only workflows can enter Completing — VOs complete immediately regardless of links
Links keyed by (local_service_id, remote_service_id, edge_label) with edge_label in key
HandlerInvocation creates Exclusive handler invocation on parent VO
decisions: are_linked(a, b) checks both directions — used for cycle prevention in CreateLink
VO clear state preserves ChildOf records — only deletes outgoing ParentOf links and notifies children
Removed label field entirely — links identified by child_service_id, not arbitrary label string
Extracted cancel_linked_children helper used by cancel (Invoked/Suspended/Paused + Completing) and kill (Completing)
Link barrier check moved outside sinks/retention guard — workflows always enter Completing with running links
No active_children_count — query link table for Running links instead of maintaining denormalized counter
Completion delivers Result<T, E> only — no status field, no inline frozen graph
Completing variant carries InFlightInvocationMetadata + buffered ResponseResult
RemoveLink included in MVP — graph curation is load-bearing
End-to-end integration test included in MVP scope
Cancellation is local per node — each node cancels its own direct children
HandlerInvocation targets VirtualObjectHandlerType::Exclusive — handler runs under object's exclusive lock
CreateLink proto uses result_completion_id field (not RawCommand metadata) matching AttachInvocation pattern
Lite decoding for CreateLink/RemoveLink returns graceful DecodingError — DataFusion skips these entries
open_questions: Failure argument encoding for onCompleted: should it be proto-encoded InvocationError, JSON, or raw bytes?
Graph traversal API — how does a parent inspect the frozen state graph of completed children? (deferred)
Orphan GC policy — default timeout for orphaned workflows? (deferred)
